units.source_text: 他剛剛搖搖晃晃地起身下樓，咋這麼快又上來了。

en.t: He had only just staggered to his feet and gone downstairs, so how had he come back up so quickly?

units.source_text: 「怎麼了？」周圍的氣氛異常緊張，

en.t: What is it? The atmosphere around us was strangely tense,

units.source_text: 我們倆從樓頂下到二樓，再從二樓下到我一樓房間的樓梯上，

en.t: The two of us went down from the rooftop to the second floor, then from the second floor onto the stairs leading to my room on the first floor,

units.source_text: 堀木停下腳步，用手指著小聲說道：「你看！」

en.t: Horiki stopped, pointed with his finger, and whispered, Look!

units.source_text: 我家房間上方的小窗敞開著，房間內可一覽無餘。

en.t: The small window above my room was open, and the whole room could be seen clearly.
The light was on, and there were two animals.

units.source_text: 我感到頭暈目眩，急促呼吸的同時，在心中不停地嘀咕：「看看，這就是人的姿態！這就是人的姿態！沒必要去大驚小怪。」

en.t: I felt dizzy and breathless, and kept muttering inwardly, Look, this is what people are like! This is what people are like! There is no need to make a fuss.

units.source_text: 我甚至忘了去救良子，呆立在樓梯上。

en.t: I even forgot to save Yoshiko and stood frozen on the stairs.
Horiki cleared his throat loudly several times.
